passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.1
passages.text: Perlegis? an coniunx prohibet nova? perlege — non est

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.2
passages.text: Ista Mycenaea littera facta manu!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.3
passages.text: Pegasis Oenone, Phrygiis celeberrima silvis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.4
passages.text: Laesa queror de te, si sinis ipse, meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.5
passages.text: Quis deus opposuit nostris sua numina votis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.6
passages.text: Ne tua permaneam, quod mihi crimen obest?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.7
passages.text: Leniter, ex merito quidquid patiare, ferendum est;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.8
passages.text: Quae venit indigno poena, dolenda venit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.9
passages.text: Nondum tantus eras, cum te contenta marito

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.10
passages.text: Edita de magno flumine nympha fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.11
passages.text: Qui nunc Priamides — absit reverentia vero! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.12
passages.text: Servus eras; servo nubere nympha tuli!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.13
passages.text: Saepe greges inter requievimus arbore tecti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.14
passages.text: Mixtaque cum foliis praebuit herba torum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.15
passages.text: Saepe super stramen faenoque iacentibus alto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.16
passages.text: Defensa est humili cana pruina casa.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.17
passages.text: Quis tibi monstrabat saltus venatibus aptos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.18
passages.text: Et tegeret catulos qua fera rupe suos?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.19
passages.text: Retia saepe comes maculis distincta tetendi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.20
passages.text: Saepe citos egi per iuga longa canes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.21
passages.text: Incisae servant a te mea nomina fagi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.22
passages.text: Et legor Oenone falce notata tua,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.25
passages.text: Et quantum trunci, tantum mea nomina crescunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.26
passages.text: Crescite et in titulos surgite recta meos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.27
passages.text: Popule, vive, precor, quae consita margine ripae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.28
passages.text: Hoc in rugoso cortice carmen habes:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.29
passages.text: Cum Paris Oenone poterit spirare relicta,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.30
passages.text: Ad fontem Xanthi versa recurret aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.31
passages.text: Xanthe, retro propera, versaeque recurrite lymphae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.32
passages.text: Sustinet Oenonen deseruisse Paris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.33
passages.text: Illa dies fatum miserae mihi dixit, ab illa

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.34
passages.text: Pessima mutati coepit amoris hiemps,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.35
passages.text: Qua Venus et Iuno sumptisque decentior armis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.36
passages.text: Venit in arbitrium nuda Minerva tuum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.37
passages.text: Attoniti micuere sinus, gelidusque cucurrit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.38
passages.text: Ut mihi narrasti, dura per ossa tremor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.39
passages.text: Consului — neque enim modice terrebar — anusque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.40
passages.text: Longaevosque senes. constitit esse nefas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.41
passages.text: Caesa abies, sectaeque trabes, et classe parata

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.42
passages.text: Caerula ceratas accipit unda rates.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.43
passages.text: Flesti discedens — hoc saltim parce negare!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.44
passages.text: Miscuimus lacrimas maestus uterque suas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.45
passages.text: Non sic adpositis vincitur vitibus ulmus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.46
passages.text: Ut tua sunt collo bracchia nexa meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.47
passages.text: A! quotiens, cum te vento quererere teneri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.50
passages.text: Riserunt comites — ille secundus erat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.51
passages.text: Oscula dimissae quotiens repetita dedisti!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.52
passages.text: Quam vix sustinuit dicere lingua 'vale'!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.53
passages.text: Aura levis rigido pendentia lintea malo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.54
passages.text: Suscitat, et remis eruta canet aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.55
passages.text: Prosequor infelix oculis abeuntia vela,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.56
passages.text: Qua licet, et lacrimis umet harena meis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.57
passages.text: Utque celer venias, virides Nereidas oro —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.58
passages.text: Scilicet ut venias in mea damna celer!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.59
passages.text: Votis ergo meis alii rediture redisti?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.60
passages.text: Ei mihi, pro dira paelice blanda fui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.61
passages.text: Adspicit inmensum moles nativa profundum —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.62
passages.text: Mons fuit; aequoreis illa resistit aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.63
passages.text: Hinc ego vela tuae cognovi prima carinae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.64
passages.text: Et mihi per fluctus impetus ire fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.65
passages.text: Dum moror, in summa fulsit mihi purpura prora —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.66
passages.text: Pertimui; cultus non erat ille tuus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.67
passages.text: Fit propior terrasque cita ratis attigit aura;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.68
passages.text: Femineas vidi corde tremente genas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.69
passages.text: Non satis id fuerat — quid enim furiosa morabar? —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.70
passages.text: Haerebat gremio turpis amica tuo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.71
passages.text: Tunc vero rupique sinus et pectora planxi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.72
passages.text: Et secui madidas ungue rigente genas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.73
passages.text: Inplevique sacram querulis ululatibus Iden

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.74
passages.text: Illuc has lacrimas in mea saxa tuli.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.75
passages.text: Sic Helene doleat defectaque coniuge ploret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.76
passages.text: Quaeque prior nobis intulit, ipsa ferat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.77
passages.text: Nunc tibi conveniunt, quae te per aperta sequantur

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.78
passages.text: Aequora legitimos destituantque viros;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.79
passages.text: At cum pauper eras armentaque pastor agebas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.80
passages.text: Nulla nisi Oenone pauperis uxor erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.81
passages.text: Non ego miror opes, nec me tua regia tangit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.82
passages.text: Nec de tot Priami dicar ut una nurus —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.83
passages.text: Non tamen ut Priamus nymphae socer esse recuset,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.84
passages.text: Aut Hecubae fuerim dissimulanda nurus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.85
passages.text: Dignaque sum fieri rerum matrona potentis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.86
passages.text: Sunt mihi, quas possint sceptra decere, manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.87
passages.text: Nec me, faginea quod tecum fronde iacebam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.88
passages.text: Despice; purpureo sum magis apta toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.89
passages.text: Denique tutus amor meus est; ibi nulla parantur

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.90
passages.text: Bella, nec ultrices advehit unda rates.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.91
passages.text: Tyndaris infestis fugitiva reposcitur armis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.92
passages.text: Hac venit in thalamos dote superba tuos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.93
passages.text: Quae si sit Danais reddenda, vel Hectora fratrem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.94
passages.text: Vel cum Deiphobo Polydamanta roga;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.95
passages.text: Quid gravis Antenor, Priamus quid suadeat ipse,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.96
passages.text: Consule, quis aetas longa magistra fuit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.97
passages.text: Turpe rudimentum, patriae praeponere raptam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.98
passages.text: Causa pudenda tua est; iusta vir arma movet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.99
passages.text: Nec tibi, si sapias, fidam promitte Lacaenam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.100
passages.text: Quae sit in amplexus tam cito versa tuos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.101
passages.text: Ut minor Atrides temerati foedera lecti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.102
passages.text: Clamat et externo laesus amore dolet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.103
passages.text: Tu quoque clamabis. nulla reparabilis arte

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.104
passages.text: Laesa pudicitia est; deperit illa semel.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.105
passages.text: Ardet amore tui? sic et Menelaon amavit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.106
passages.text: Nunc iacet in viduo credulus ille toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.107
passages.text: Felix Andromache, certo bene nupta marito!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.108
passages.text: Uxor ad exemplum fratris habenda fui;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.109
passages.text: Tu levior foliis, tum cum sine pondere suci

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.110
passages.text: Mobilibus ventis arida facta volant;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.111
passages.text: Et minus est in te quam summa pondus arista,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.112
passages.text: Quae levis adsiduis solibus usta riget.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.113
passages.text: Hoc tua — nam recolo — quondam germana canebat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.114
passages.text: Sic mihi diffusis vaticinata comis:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.115
passages.text: 'Quid facis, Oenone? quid harenae semina mandas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.116
passages.text: Non profecturis litora bubus aras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.117
passages.text: Graia iuvenca venit, quae te patriamque domumque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.118
passages.text: Perdat! io prohibe! Graia iuvenca venit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.119
passages.text: Dum licet, obscenam ponto demergite puppim!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.120
passages.text: Heu! quantum Phrygii sanguinis illa vehit!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.121
passages.text: Vox erat in cursu: famulae rapuere furentem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.122
passages.text: At mihi flaventes diriguere comae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.123
passages.text: A, nimium miserae vates mihi vera fuisti —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.124
passages.text: Possidet, en, saltus illa iuvenca meos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.125
passages.text: Sit facie quamvis insignis, adultera certe est;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.126
passages.text: Deseruit socios hospite capta deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.127
passages.text: Illam de patria Theseus — nisi nomine fallor —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.128
passages.text: Nescio quis Theseus abstulit ante sua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.129
passages.text: A iuvene et cupido credatur reddita virgo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.130
passages.text: Unde hoc conpererim tam bene, quaeris? amo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.131
passages.text: Vim licet appelles et culpam nomine veles;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.132
passages.text: Quae totiens rapta est, praebuit ipsa rapi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.133
passages.text: At manet Oenone fallenti casta marito —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.134
passages.text: Et poteras falli legibus ipse tuis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.135
passages.text: Me Satyri celeres — silvis ego tecta latebam —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.136
passages.text: Quaesierunt rapido, turba proterva, pede

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.137
passages.text: Cornigerumque caput pinu praecinctus acuta

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.138
passages.text: Faunus in inmensis, qua tumet Ida, iugis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.139
passages.text: Me fide conspicuus Troiae munitor amavit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.140
passages.text: Admisitque meas ad sua dona manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.141
passages.text: Quaecumque herba potens ad opem radixque medenti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.142
passages.text: Utilis in toto nascitur orbe, mea est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.143
passages.text: Me miseram, quod amor non est medicabilis herbis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.150
passages.text: Deficior prudens artis ab arte mea.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.151
passages.text: Quod nec graminibus tellus fecunda creandis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.152
passages.text: Nec deus, auxilium tu mihi ferre potes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.155
passages.text: Et potes, et merui — dignae miserere puellae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.156
passages.text: Non ego cum Danais arma cruenta fero —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.157
passages.text: Sed tua sum tecumque fui puerilibus annis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 5.158
passages.text: Et tua, quod superest temporis, esse precor!
